title: Technical English — Course 3, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 11

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the industry overview begin?
tasks.audioText: The college aviation department is organising an industry overview on Thursday at ten. A guest speaker from an aircraft maintenance organisation will describe the roles of technicians, planners and stores staff. The talk will take place in Lecture Room 1. Students should prepare one question about the skills needed for an entry-level role.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which preparation material is required before the technical lesson?
tasks.audioText: The college aviation department is organising an industry overview on Thursday at ten. A guest speaker from an aircraft maintenance organisation will describe the roles of technicians, planners and stores staff. The talk will take place in Lecture Room 1. Students should prepare one question about the skills needed for an entry-level role.
options: One question about preferred working hours
One question about the company's annual turnover

tasks.prompt: Aircraft maintenance organisations employ people with different responsibilities. Technicians inspect and maintain components, planners coordinate work and documentation, and stores staff manage parts and records. These roles depend on accurate communication because a component's identity and status must be clear to everyone involved. New employees usually receive role-specific training before taking on assigned duties. Reading 1. What do planners coordinate?

options: So that reports can be shorter
So that component identity and status are clear to everyone
So that the next team can avoid checking records
So that only the outgoing team understands the status

tasks.prompt: Stores staff are responsible for ___ component records.
Choose TWO roles that may be found in an aircraft maintenance organisation.
A person who organises when maintenance tasks should be completed is a maintenance ___.
You are asking about an entry-level role. Which question is suitable?
options: Give me the job description now.
Could you describe the main responsibilities of a trainee technician?
I do not need to know the duties.
I will decide what the job includes.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of aviation industry overview in a logical order.
options: Check the skills and training required
Identify the organisation and its activities
Learn about the different job roles
correctOrder: Identify the organisation and its activities
Learn about the different job roles
Check the skills and training required

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words describing two roles in an aviation maintenance organisation and explaining why they need to communicate accurately.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: two relevant aviation-maintenance roles are identified and their responsibilities are distinguished (0–2); the response explains why accurate communication or handover matters between them (0–2); ideas are logically organised with understandable grammar (0–2); maintenance-role/communication vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
